prompt: Create a vertical cinematic portrait in a warm, sepia-toned rustic room. A handsome young man with deep burgundy button-up shirt, dark jeans, and sneakers is crouching on the left side, gently touching one finger to the raised paw of a golden retriever puppy sitting on the right. The puppy has soft golden fur, floppy ears, and wears a black-and-white checkered bandana. Behind them on the textured plaster wall, include a large charcoal-pencil mural or sketch of a smiling young woman in a loose hoodie interacting with a sketched version of the same puppy, echoing the real pose; the mural should look hand-drawn, monochrome, and integrated into the wall texture. Use dramatic golden window light from the upper left, casting clear diagonal window-frame shadows across the wall and floor. The mood is tender, nostalgic, and slightly magical, blending photorealistic foreground figures with a delicate wall illustration. Use shallow depth of field, realistic skin and fur detail, soft dust in the light, warm earthy colors, and a cinematic fine-art photography style. No text, no watermark, no extra animals or people.

promptZh: 创作一张竖构图的电影级肖像，背景是一个色调温暖、充满怀旧感的乡村风格房间。左侧蹲着一名英俊的年轻男子，他穿着 深酒红色 衬衫、深色牛仔裤和运动鞋，正用手指轻轻触碰右侧坐着的金毛寻回犬幼犬抬起的爪子。幼犬有着柔软的金色毛发、下垂的耳朵，并戴着黑白格纹头巾。在他们身后纹理粗糙的灰泥墙上，绘制一幅大型炭笔壁画或素描，画中是一名穿着宽松连帽衫的年轻女性，正与画中同样姿势的幼犬互动；壁画应呈现出手绘、单色且与墙面纹理融为一体的效果。利用从左上方射入的戏剧性金色窗光，在墙壁和地板上投下清晰的对角线窗框阴影。整体氛围温柔、怀旧且带有一丝魔幻感，将写实的前景人物与细腻的墙面插画完美融合。采用浅景深效果，展现逼真的皮肤和毛发细节，光影中漂浮着柔和的尘埃，色调为温暖的土色系，呈现电影级艺术摄影风格。画面中不含文字、水印，且没有其他动物或人物。
